column1: # The pinned sample of a landing of the stage (the repository's landing rule r9, item 9: a fix lands on the rows it targets plus a
# pinned at-risk sample, in minutes; the whole set runs once, for the closure claim). A landing that changes lib/lrc runs, at its head:
#   lean --run instruments/lrc-host/Diff.rsd plants                    every planted row of every table still names one line
#   lean --run instruments/lrc-host/Diff.rsd rsdc                      the front end takes the stage's modules
#   the compiled host check as `quick` (Diff.rsd emit, DIR/0.lean)      every image row, the default pipeline, six budgets; the bytes
#                                                                       live at most under narrow fields for the rows of Peaks.tsv
#   Sides.rsd NATIVE 40 and the `image` rows below                      the real compiler, both lowerings and the stage's module of
#   the `planted` rows below, and every row of a table that names a line the landing changes
#   the `sides` rows below when the landing changes a guard, a call's depth or lib/lrc/Emit.rsd
# The sample holds a row of every table and of every pass that has rows: a row far from a change found the one defect that a whole
# replay found on 2026-11-18 (a helper that switched lib/lrc/Pack.rsd off; MutantsCover row 53).

column2: NAME (an image row of Images.tsv) or TABLE:ROW (a row of instruments/lrc-host/Mutants<TABLE>.tsv; BASE is Mutants.tsv; Sides is SidesMutants.tsv)
